kept.poolKey: First-Survey qualification (the reading is a first look)
kept.spine: The town has been seen once and not lived in, and how safe it is has been taken from the one look.
Nothing at Hochhausen is run at another's word, and no interest here has a hand on the town's own business.
No wall stands here. Where the town ends is a matter of the last roof and the first field.
Nothing in the town is set against what it cannot see.
The grazing land and the last houses are in among one another, and nothing has been put up to tell them apart.
